cards.name: Bypass
cards.description: Leave this slot untouched. No TCL commands are emitted for this slot.

notes: No TCL commands are emitted for bypassed slots.

cards.name: No adapter board
cards.description: Remove generated block design content for this adapter slot.

notes: Deletes external ports and hierarchy pins matching this slot.
Deletes the slot adapter hierarchy if it exists.
AXI boundary cleanup is handled by the shared AXI interconnect template.

cards.name: Analog LTC2311-16
cards.description: Analog A-slot adapter card using the ADC_LTC2311 IP core.

notes: Creates uz_analog_adapter/Ax_adapter for the selected A-slot.
Instantiates the ADC_LTC2311 IP core with the default adapter-card parameters.
Exposes the slot-specific ADC ports through the uz_analog_adapter hierarchy.
Connects AXI through the A-slot project-level AXI attachment point.
Contributes 8 packed 16-bit ADC samples to the AXI2TCM DataMover path.

cards.name: Analog MAX11331
cards.description: Analog A-slot adapter card using the ADC_MAX11331_top IP core.

notes: Creates uz_analog_adapter/Ax_adapter for the selected A-slot.
Instantiates the ADC_MAX11331_top IP core and standard xlconcat fanout helpers.
Routes MAX11331 SPI signals to slot-specific vector ports with generated concat fanout logic.
Connects AXI through the A-slot project-level AXI attachment point.
Contributes 24 packed 16-bit ADC samples to the AXI2TCM DataMover path.
Generate slot-local MAX11331 initialization.
Read 24 packed 16-bit samples from the AXI2TCM DataMover buffer.

cards.name: Analog DAC8831
cards.description: Analog A-slot adapter card with eight DAC8831 output channels.

notes: Creates uz_analog_adapter/Ax_adapter for the selected A-slot.
Instantiates the uz_dac_spi_interface IP core and ten OBUFDS utility buffers.
Routes SPI clock, chip select and eight DAC data outputs to slot-specific differential ports.
Connects AXI through the A-slot project-level AXI attachment point.
Does not participate in the AXI2TCM ADC data mover path.
Generate slot-local DAC initialization.
Write zero volts to all DAC channels until a configurable signal source is added.

cards.name: UZ_D 3-Phase Inverter
cards.description: Digital inverter adapter card using uz_d_inverter_adapter plus the mapping IP core.

notes: Create a hierarchy for the inverter adapter.
Instantiate uz_d_inverter_adapter v1.1.
Create the adapter-board ports and the small slice/concat plumbing directly.
Connect Gates[5:0] from a configurable block-design gate vector slice, with local zero fallback if the selected source is missing.
Connect PWM_UZ_Enable from a configurable block-design source pin, with local zero fallback if the selected source is missing.
Expose top-level ports with Digital_AdapterBoard_Dx.xdc Dig_XX_Chx names and disable the packed D-slot constraint file.

source_fields.label: Gate vector source
source_fields.help: Six-bit vector source pin for one two-level PWM gate-signal instance.

source_fields.label: PWM_UZ_Enable source
source_fields.help: Single-bit source pin that drives uz_d_inverter_adapter PWM_UZ_Enable. Leave empty or use an invalid path to fall back to zero.

notes: Generate uz_inverter_adapter_init.c/.h.
Add object pointer to globalData.h.
Initialize the driver in main.c.

cards.name: UZ_D Optical IO
cards.description: Digital optical adapter card with selectable 14TX4RX, 18TX, or 18RX population.

notes: Routes the selected optical IO population through the slot CPLD.
Instantiates one AXI GPIO when at least one IO pin is AXI-backed.
Only Dig_00 through Dig_17 are used for the optical card.
Uses single-pin D-slot constraints instead of the packed constraint file.
Generate one AXI GPIO driver instance if at least one IO pin is AXI-backed.
Expose AXI GPIO-backed IO pins for visualization.

cards.name: UZ_D Voltage 3V3/5V
cards.description: Digital voltage 3V3/5V adapter card with four hardware direction groups.

notes: Routes all 30 voltage IO pins according to the four hardware direction groups.
The selected group directions determine the slot CPLD program.
Instantiates one AXI GPIO when at least one IO pin is AXI-backed.
Uses single-pin D-slot constraints instead of the packed constraint file.
Generate one AXI GPIO driver instance if at least one IO pin is AXI-backed.
Expose AXI GPIO-backed IO pins for visualization.

cards.name: UZ_D Voltage RS422
cards.description: Digital voltage RS422 adapter card with selectable 30TX, 20TX10RX, or 30RX population.

notes: Routes all 30 RS422 IO pins according to the selected adapter population.
The selected RS422 variant determines the slot CPLD program.
Instantiates one AXI GPIO when at least one IO pin is AXI-backed.
Uses single-pin D-slot constraints instead of the packed constraint file.
Generate one AXI GPIO driver instance if at least one IO pin is AXI-backed.
Expose AXI GPIO-backed IO pins for visualization.

cards.name: UZ_D Incremental Encoder
cards.description: Incremental encoder adapter card using the Incremental_Encoder_v26 IP core.

notes: Creates the selected Dx_adapter hierarchy for three fixed incremental encoder IP cores.
Routes the encoder index, A and B inputs from the slot-specific digital adapter pins.
Connects PeriodEnd to a configurable trigger source.
Connects AXI through the D-slot project-level AXI attachment point.
Uses single-pin D-slot constraints instead of the packed constraint file.

source_fields.label: PeriodEnd source pin
source_fields.help: Block-design pin used to latch/update the incremental encoder period measurement. The legacy design used the conversion-trigger path.

notes: Generate slot-local incremental encoder initialization.
Read encoder position, speed and index status in the slot ISR update function.

cards.name: UZ_D Absolute Encoder
cards.description: Absolute encoder adapter card with three encoder channels. Each channel can be configured independently, e.g. EnDat or SSI.

notes: Instantiate one encoder IP core per enabled channel inside uz_user.
Connect AXI4-Lite, 100 MHz clock and reset for every enabled channel.
Connect channel triggers to the intended trigger source.
D-slot channel mappings use Dig_XX_Chx names where x is the slot channel number.
Generate one init file or init section per enabled channel.
Add object pointer to globalData.h.
Initialize and enable the IP in main.c after xparameters.h contains the base address.

cards.name: UZ_D Resolver
cards.description: Resolver adapter card using one Resolver Interface IP core per available AD2S1210 channel, optionally followed by the resolver PL interface IP core.

notes: Creates the selected Dx_adapter hierarchy for the resolver IP cores.
Routes the AD2S1210 SPI and control signals from the slot-specific digital adapter pins.
Connects sample_trigger to a configurable trigger source.
Optionally instantiates one resolver PL interface IP core per resolver channel.
Uses single-pin D-slot constraints instead of the packed constraint file.

source_fields.label: Channel 1 sample trigger source pin
source_fields.help: Block-design pin used to trigger resolver channel 1 sampling.

source_fields.label: Channel 2 sample trigger source pin
source_fields.help: Block-design pin used to trigger resolver channel 2 sampling.

source_fields.label: Channel 3 sample trigger source pin
source_fields.help: Block-design pin used to trigger resolver channel 3 sampling.

options.label: Channel 1 PL interface
options.help: When enabled, resolver channel 1 feeds one resolver_pl_interface IP. The PL-interface trigger is hard-wired to resolver valid_m.

options.label: Channel 2 PL interface
options.help: When enabled, resolver channel 2 feeds one resolver_pl_interface IP. The PL-interface trigger is hard-wired to resolver valid_m.

options.label: Channel 3 PL interface
options.help: When enabled, resolver channel 3 feeds one resolver_pl_interface IP. The PL-interface trigger is hard-wired to resolver valid_m.

notes: Generate one resolver IP driver instance per available resolver channel.
When enabled, generate one resolver PL interface driver instance per resolver channel.
Read processed PL-interface angle and speed values in the slot ISR update function.

cards.name: UZ_D Temperature LTC2983
cards.description: Temperature measurement adapter card using the Temperature_Card_Interface IP core.

notes: Instantiate Temperature_Card_Interface in uz_digital_adapter/Dx_adapter.
Use single-pin D-slot constraints instead of the packed constraint file.
D5 requires a custom CPLD file and is intentionally not listed as compatible.
